title: Wooden Barrel
summary: Movable wooden barrel with 4 HP and Fire vulnerability.

fields.Durability: 4 HP. Resists Piercing, is vulnerable to Bludgeoning and Fire, and is immune to Poison and Psychic.
fields.Handling: Standard lightweight storage barrel, about 22 lb. The indexed standard, alchemy-room and grove object variants share this durability.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
